# Ringkasan

Analisis PDRB kabupaten/kota Indonesia tahun 2019 menggunakan OLS, SAR, SEM, dan *Eigenvector Spatial Filtering* (ESF).

- n = 497 kabupaten/kota (termasuk DKI Jakarta)
- Respons: PDRB · Prediktor: PAD, JTK, IPM
- Pembobot spasial: 4-nearest neighbours (KNN)
- `spmoran::meigen()` + `spmoran::esf()` (forward stepwise, `fn = "r2"`)

# Persiapan

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  eval = TRUE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE
)
```

```{r packages}
library(knitr)
library(openxlsx)
library(sf)
library(spdep)
library(spatialreg)
library(spmoran)
library(car)
library(lmtest)
library(prettymapr)
```

# Deskripsi Peubah

```{r tabel-peubah}
tabel_peubah <- data.frame(
```

# Import Data

```{r import-data}
dataindo <- read.xlsx("data/Data BAB 4.xlsx")

vars_num <- c("PDRB", "PAD", "JTK", "IPM")
dataindo[vars_num] <- lapply(dataindo[vars_num], as.numeric)

colSums(is.na(dataindo[vars_num]))
```

```{r validasi-data}
stopifnot(
  all(sapply(dataindo[vars_num], is.numeric)),
  all(complete.cases(dataindo[vars_num]))
)

cat("Jumlah observasi:", nrow(dataindo), "\n")
```

```{r cek-n}
if (nrow(dataindo) != 497) {
  warning(
    paste(
      "Jumlah observasi pada file Excel adalah", nrow(dataindo),
      "bukan 497. Periksa isi data sebelum melanjutkan."
    )
  )
}
```

# Penggabungan Data Spasial

## Import Shapefile

```{r import-shapefile}
peta1 <- st_read(
  "data/gadm41_IDN_shp/gadm41_IDN_2.shp",
  quiet = TRUE
)

cat("Jumlah wilayah shapefile awal:", nrow(peta1), "\n")
st_crs(peta1)
```

## Penyesuaian Jumlah Wilayah

Shapefile GADM level-2 memiliki 502 fitur, data Excel memiliki 497 observasi. Lima fitur shapefile non-kabupaten/kota pada baris 60, 107, 140, 428, dan 473 dikeluarkan agar jumlahnya sama.

```{r penyesuaian-jumlah-wilayah}
peta1 <- peta1[-60, ]
peta1 <- peta1[-107, ]
peta1 <- peta1[-140, ]
peta1 <- peta1[-428, ]
peta1 <- peta1[-473, ]

stopifnot(nrow(dataindo) == nrow(peta1))
cat("n =", nrow(peta1), "\n")
```

```{r cek-jakarta}
dataindo[
  grepl("Jakarta", dataindo$prov, ignore.case = TRUE) |
  grepl("Jakarta", dataindo$name, ignore.case = TRUE),
  c("prov", "name", "PDRB", "PAD", "JTK", "IPM")
]

peta1[
  grepl("Jakarta", peta1$NAME_1, ignore.case = TRUE) |
  grepl("Jakarta", peta1$NAME_2, ignore.case = TRUE),
  c("NAME_1", "NAME_2")
]
```

```{r tambah-variabel-peta}
peta1$PDRB <- dataindo$PDRB
peta1$PAD  <- dataindo$PAD
peta1$JTK  <- dataindo$JTK
peta1$IPM  <- dataindo$IPM
```

# Menyusun Data Analisis

```{r data-frame}
# cbind() dihindari karena dapat mengubah seluruh kolom numerik menjadi character
data <- data.frame(
  PDRB = dataindo$PDRB,
  PAD  = dataindo$PAD,
  JTK  = dataindo$JTK,
  IPM  = dataindo$IPM
)

stopifnot(
  nrow(data) == nrow(peta1),
  all(sapply(data, is.numeric)),
  all(complete.cases(data))
)
```

## Koordinat Centroid

```{r centroid}
peta_ll <- st_transform(peta1, 4326)
peta_metric <- st_transform(peta_ll, 6933)

centroid_metric <- st_centroid(peta_metric, of_largest_polygon = TRUE)
centroid_ll <- st_transform(centroid_metric, 4326)

coords <- st_coordinates(centroid_ll)
lon <- coords[, 1]
lat <- coords[, 2]
```

```{r data-full}
datafull <- data.frame(
  prov = peta1$NAME_1,
  name = peta1$NAME_2,
  lon  = lon,
  lat  = lat,
  PDRB = dataindo$PDRB,
  PAD  = dataindo$PAD,
  JTK  = dataindo$JTK,
  IPM  = dataindo$IPM
)

stopifnot(
  nrow(datafull) == nrow(data),
  all(datafull$PDRB == data$PDRB),
  all(datafull$PAD  == data$PAD),
  all(datafull$JTK  == data$JTK),
  all(datafull$IPM  == data$IPM)
)
```

```{r peta-sebaran, fig.width=10, fig.height=7}
k <- 8
colfunc <- colorRampPalette(c("#F7FBFF", "#6BAED6", "#08306B"))

plot(

  nbreaks = k,

```

## Rata-Rata PDRB per Provinsi

```{r rata-pdrb-provinsi}
pdrbprov <- aggregate(PDRB ~ prov, data = datafull, FUN = mean)
names(pdrbprov) <- c("Provinsi", "PDRB")
pdrbprov <- pdrbprov[order(pdrbprov$PDRB, decreasing = TRUE), ]
```

```{r grafik-pdrb-provinsi, fig.width=12, fig.height=7}
k <- nrow(pdrbprov)
warna_biru <- hcl.colors(k, palette = "Blues 3")

oldpar <- par(mar = c(8, 6, 2, 2))

grafik <- barplot(

text(
```

# Model OLS

```{r model-ols}
model_ols <- lm(PDRB ~ PAD + JTK + IPM, data = data)
summary(model_ols)
```

# Multikolinearitas

```{r uji-vif}
vif_hasil <- vif(model_ols)
vif_hasil
```

```{r tabel-vif}
tabel_vif <- data.frame(
  Variabel = names(vif_hasil),
  VIF = round(as.numeric(vif_hasil), 4)
)
kable(tabel_vif)
```

# Matriks Pembobot Spasial

```{r bobot-knn}
coords_mat <- as.matrix(datafull[, c("lon", "lat")])

col.knn <- knearneigh(coords_mat, k = 4, longlat = TRUE)
bobotknn1 <- knn2nb(col.knn)
bobotknn <- nb2listw(bobotknn1, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)
cmat <- nb2mat(bobotknn1, style = "B", zero.policy = TRUE)
```

```{r cek-bobot}
cat("Jumlah wilayah:", length(bobotknn1), "\n")
cat("Dimensi C      :", paste(dim(cmat), collapse = " x "), "\n")
summary(bobotknn1)
```

```{r plot-knn, fig.width=10, fig.height=7}
plot(st_geometry(peta_ll), border = "grey", main = "K-nearest Neighbours (k = 4)")
plot(bobotknn1, coords_mat, add = TRUE)
```

```{r moran}
moran1 <- moran.test(data$PDRB, bobotknn, zero.policy = TRUE)
moran1
```

```{r moran-normal}
moran2 <- moran.test(
  data$PDRB, bobotknn,
  randomisation = FALSE, alternative = "greater", zero.policy = TRUE
)
moran2
```

```{r moran-plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=7}
moranplot <- moran.plot(data$PDRB, bobotknn, labels = datafull$name, zero.policy = TRUE)
```

# Uji Heteroskedastisitas

```{r uji-bp}
ujiBP <- bptest(model_ols)
ujiBP
```

# Uji Dependensi Spasial

```{r uji-rs}
# spdep versi terbaru memakai istilah Rao's score (RS) untuk uji yang
# secara historis dikenal sebagai LM test
uji_rs <- lm.RStests(model_ols, listw = bobotknn, zero.policy = TRUE, test = "all")
summary(uji_rs)
```

```{r uji-lm-historis}
uji_lm <- lm.LMtests(
  model_ols, listw = bobotknn, zero.policy = TRUE,
  test = c("LMerr", "LMlag", "RLMerr", "RLMlag", "SARMA")
)
summary(uji_lm)
```

# Model SAR

```{r model-sar}
sar <- lagsarlm(
  PDRB ~ PAD + JTK + IPM, data = data,
  listw = bobotknn, tol.solve = 1e-5, zero.policy = TRUE
)
summary(sar, Nagelkerke = TRUE)
```

```{r koef-sar}
coef_sar <- summary(sar)$Coef
coef_sar
```

```{r pred-sar}
predsar <- as.numeric(fitted(sar))
```

# Model SEM

```{r model-sem}
sem <- errorsarlm(
  PDRB ~ PAD + JTK + IPM, data = data,
  listw = bobotknn, zero.policy = TRUE
)
summary(sem, Nagelkerke = TRUE)
```

```{r koef-sem}
coef_sem <- summary(sem)$Coef
coef_sem
```

```{r pred-sem}
predsem <- as.numeric(fitted(sem))
```

# Model ESF

```{r eigen-esf}
meig <- meigen(cmat = cmat, threshold = 0.25)
eigenvector <- meig$ev
cat("Jumlah eigenvector kandidat:", length(eigenvector), "\n")
```

```{r model-esf}
Y <- data$PDRB
X <- as.matrix(data[, c("PAD", "JTK", "IPM")])

# forward stepwise berdasarkan adjusted-R2 (default fn = "r2")
res <- esf(y = Y, x = X, meig = meig, fn = "r2")
res
```

```{r jumlah-eigenvector}
jumlah_eigen_terpilih <- nrow(res$r)
cat("Jumlah eigenvector terpilih:", jumlah_eigen_terpilih, "\n")
```

```{r koef-esf}
coef_esf <- res$b
coef_esf
```

```{r statistik-esf}
res$e
```

## Random-Effects ESF (RE-ESF)

```{r model-resf}
resf_model <- resf(y = Y, x = X, meig = meig, method = "reml")
resf_model
```

# Evaluasi Kinerja Model

```{r rmse-function}
RMSE <- function(pred, obs) sqrt(mean((pred - obs)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r pred-esf}
predres <- as.numeric(res$pred)
RMSEres <- RMSE(predres, Y)
```

```{r pred-resf}
# resf_model$pred dapat berupa matriks/data.frame atau list tergantung versi spmoran
pred_obj <- resf_model$pred

if (is.matrix(pred_obj) || is.data.frame(pred_obj)) {
  if ("pred" %in% colnames(pred_obj)) {
    predresf <- as.numeric(pred_obj[, "pred"])
  } else {
    predresf <- as.numeric(pred_obj[, 1])
  }
} else if (is.list(pred_obj) && !is.null(pred_obj$pred)) {
  predresf <- as.numeric(pred_obj$pred)
} else {
  stop("Format resf_model$pred tidak dikenali. Jalankan str(resf_model$pred) untuk pemeriksaan.")
}

RMSEresf <- RMSE(predresf, Y)
```

```{r rmse-all}
RMSEsar <- RMSE(predsar, Y)
RMSEsem <- RMSE(predsem, Y)

RMSEsar
RMSEsem
RMSEres
RMSEresf
```

# Adjusted-R2 SAR dan SEM

```{r adjusted-r2}
# Dihitung dari RSS/TSS agar sebanding secara deskriptif dengan OLS/ESF;
# AIC dan log-likelihood tetap jadi ukuran utama untuk model spasial
n <- nrow(data)
p <- 3

rss_sar <- sum((predsar - Y)^2, na.rm = TRUE)
tss <- sum((Y - mean(Y))^2, na.rm = TRUE)
rsq_sar <- 1 - rss_sar / tss
adj_r2_sar <- 1 - ((1 - rsq_sar) * (n - 1) / (n - p - 1))

rss_sem <- sum((predsem - Y)^2, na.rm = TRUE)
rsq_sem <- 1 - rss_sem / tss
adj_r2_sem <- 1 - ((1 - rsq_sem) * (n - 1) / (n - p - 1))

adj_r2_sar
adj_r2_sem
```

# Ukuran Kebaikan Model

```{r gof-esf}
aic_esf <- as.numeric(res$e["AIC", 1])
adj_r2_esf <- as.numeric(res$e["adjR2", 1])
loglik_esf <- as.numeric(res$e["logLik", 1])
bic_esf <- as.numeric(res$e["BIC", 1])
```

```{r gof-sar-sem}
aic_sar <- AIC(sar)
aic_sem <- AIC(sem)
```

```{r tabel-gof}
tabel_gof <- data.frame(
  Ukuran = c("AIC", "Adjusted-R2", "RMSE"),
  SAR = c(aic_sar, adj_r2_sar, RMSEsar),
  SEM = c(aic_sem, adj_r2_sem, RMSEsem),
  ESF = c(aic_esf, adj_r2_esf, RMSEres)
)

kable(tabel_gof, digits = 4)
```

# Tabel Dugaan Parameter

```{r tabel-koef}
coef_sar_vec <- coef_sar[, 1]
coef_sem_vec <- coef_sem[, 1]
coef_esf_vec <- coef_esf[, 1]

rho_sar <- sar$rho
lambda_sem <- sem$lambda

tabel_koef <- data.frame(
  Variabel = c("Intercept", "PAD", "JTK", "IPM", "rho (SAR)", "lambda (SEM)"),
  SAR = c(coef_sar_vec[c("(Intercept)", "PAD", "JTK", "IPM")], rho_sar, NA),
  SEM = c(coef_sem_vec[c("(Intercept)", "PAD", "JTK", "IPM")], NA, lambda_sem),
  ESF = c(coef_esf_vec[c("(Intercept)", "PAD", "JTK", "IPM")], NA, NA)
)

kable(tabel_koef, digits = 6)
```

# Ringkasan Hasil

```{r ringkasan-hasil}
hasil_ringkas <- data.frame(
  Model = c("OLS", "SAR", "SEM", "ESF", "RE-ESF"),
  AIC = c(
    AIC(model_ols), AIC(sar), AIC(sem), aic_esf,
    as.numeric(resf_model$e["AIC", 1])
  ),
  Adjusted_R2 = c(
    summary(model_ols)$adj.r.squared, adj_r2_sar, adj_r2_sem, adj_r2_esf,
    as.numeric(resf_model$e["adjR2(cond)", 1])
  ),
  RMSE = c(RMSE(fitted(model_ols), Y), RMSEsar, RMSEsem, RMSEres, RMSEresf)
)

kable(hasil_ringkas, digits = 4)
```

# Waktu Komputasi

```{r waktu-komputasi}
waktu_sar <- system.time({
  lagsarlm(
    PDRB ~ PAD + JTK + IPM, data = data,
    listw = bobotknn, tol.solve = 1e-5, zero.policy = TRUE
  )
})["elapsed"]

waktu_sem <- system.time({
  errorsarlm(
    PDRB ~ PAD + JTK + IPM, data = data,
    listw = bobotknn, zero.policy = TRUE
  )
})["elapsed"]

waktu_esf <- system.time({
  esf(y = Y, x = X, meig = meig, fn = "r2")
})["elapsed"]

waktu <- data.frame(
  Model = c("SAR", "SEM", "ESF"),
  Waktu_detik = c(waktu_sar, waktu_sem, waktu_esf)
)

kable(waktu, digits = 3)
```

# Peta Vektor Eigen

```{r peta-vektor-ciri, fig.width=12, fig.height=3.5}
peta_ll$e2  <- meig$sf[, 2]
peta_ll$e10 <- meig$sf[, 10]
peta_ll$e50 <- meig$sf[, 50]

plot_vektor_eigen <- function(peta, kolom, judul, k = 8, warna = c("biru", "hijau")) {
  warna <- match.arg(warna)

  pal_biru  <- colorRampPalette(c("#F7FBFF", "#6BAED6", "#08306B"))
  pal_hijau <- colorRampPalette(c("#F7FCF5", "#74C476", "#00441B"))
  colfunc <- if (warna == "biru") pal_biru else pal_hijau

  oldpar <- par(las = 1, mar = c(2, 1, 2, 1))

  plot(
    peta[kolom],
    breaks  = "quantile",
    nbreaks = k,
    pal     = colfunc,
    border  = "grey40",
    lwd     = 0.3,
    main    = judul
  )

  addnortharrow(pos = "topright", scale = 0.6)

  par(oldpar)
}

plot_vektor_eigen(peta_ll, "e2",  "(a) Vektor Eigen e2",  warna = "biru")
plot_vektor_eigen(peta_ll, "e10", "(b) Vektor Eigen e10", warna = "biru")
plot_vektor_eigen(peta_ll, "e50", "(c) Vektor Eigen e50", warna = "biru")
```
